rules.requirement: Owner must own the housing unit operated as a short-term rental.
rules.quote: An operator must own the housing unit that will be operated as a short-term rental.

rules.requirement: Owner may not operate more than one short-term rental unless the rentals are at least 1,000 feet apart.
rules.quote: Ex cept as provided in Subsection (D), an individual may operate more than one short-term rental if the short-term rentals are located at least 1,000 feet apart.

rules.requirement: Owner may not operate as short-term rentals more than the greater of one unit or 25 percent of the housing units owned on a site with four or more housing units.
rules.quote: On a site with four or more housing units, the greater of one unit or 25 percent of the housing units the person owns can be operated as short-term rentals.

rules.requirement: Owner must qualify as an individual, meaning the unit is owned by individuals, a trust whose trustees and beneficiaries are all individuals, or an LLC whose members are all individuals.
rules.quote:
In this section, an operator qualifies as an  individual when the housing unit is owned:
(1) only by one or more individuals;
(2) by a trust and each trustee and beneficiary are individuals; or
(3) by a limited liability company and each member is an individual.

rules.requirement: Owner may not obtain a new operator's license for 12 months after operating a short-term rental that was declared a nuisance.
rules.quote: A person is not eligible to obtain a new operator’s license for any short-term rental for 12 months if the person was the operator of a short-term rental that was declared a nuisance by a director or a court of competent jurisdiction.

rules.requirement: Owner must obtain an operator's license to operate a short-term rental.
rules.quote: A person must obtain an operator’s license to operate a short-term rental.

rules.requirement: Owner must hold a separate operator's license for each short-term rental unit.
rules.quote: A se parate operator’s license is required for each short-term rental.

rules.requirement: Owner must renew the operator's license at least every two years, as a license is valid for a maximum of two years.
rules.quote: is valid for a maximum of two years from the date of issuance, subject to a one-time extension of 30 days at the discretion of the director; and

rules.requirement: Owner may not transfer the operator's license, and it does not convey with a sale or transfer of the property.
rules.quote: may not be transferred and does not convey with a sale or transfer of the property.

rules.requirement: Owner must include the operator's license number in any advertisement or promotion for the short-term rental.
rules.quote: An operator must include the operator’s license number in any advertisement or promotion for the short-term rental.

rules.requirement: Owner may not advertise or promote, or allow another to advertise or promote, a short-term rental without a valid operator's license.
rules.quote: A person may not advertise or promote or allow another to advertise or promote a short-term rental if the housing unit is not the subject of a valid operator’s license.

rules.requirement: Owner must designate a local contact who is an individual present within the Austin Metro Area and authorized to make decisions and resolve emergencies.
rules.quote: Each operator must designate a local contact.

rules.requirement: Owner must ensure the local contact responds within two hours of being contacted about emergency conditions and takes action to resolve them.
rules.quote: Within two hours of being contacted about emergency conditions occurring at the short-term rental, the local contact must:

rules.requirement: Owner must ensure the local contact is present at the short-term rental within two hours if requested by a City employee.
rules.quote: A local contact must be present at the short-term rental within two hours if requested by a City employee.

rules.requirement: Owner must comply with all local, state, and federal laws and ensure guests do the same.
rules.quote: complying with all local, state, and federal laws;

rules.requirement: Owner must update application information within five days after the information changes.
rules.quote: When the information provided in an application to obtain a new operator’s license or to renew an operator’s license changes, the operator must update the information within five days after the information changes.

rules.requirement: Owner must provide a guest with exclusive use of a bedroom and shared use of a full bathroom when renting less than an entire housing unit.
rules.quote: If the short-term rental does not include an entire housing unit, an operator must provide a guest with the exclusive use of a bedroom and shared use of a full bathroom.

rules.requirement: Owner must keep the short-term rental habitable.
rules.quote: A short-term rental must be habitable.

rules.requirement: Owner must give each guest the city information packet and a list of fire extinguisher locations.
rules.quote: An operator must make the following available to each guest:

rules.requirement: Owner may not use or allow sound equipment producing sound over 75 decibels at the property line between 10:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m.
rules.quote: An operator or guest of a short-term rental may not use or allow the use of sound equipment that produces sound in excess of 75 decibels at the property line between 10:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m.

rules.requirement: Owner may not use or allow sound equipment producing sound audible beyond the property line between 10:00 p.m. and 10:00 a.m.
rules.quote: An operator or guest of a short-term rental may not use or allow use of sound equipment that produces sound audible beyond the property line between 10:00 p.m. and 10:00 a.m.

rules.requirement: Owner may not make or allow noise or musical instruments audible to an adjacent business or residence between 10:30 p.m. and 7:00 a.m.
rules.quote: An operator or guest of a short-term rental may not make or allow another to make noise or play a musical instrument audible to an adjacent business or residence between 10:30 p.m. and 7:00 a.m.

rules.requirement: Owner must implement and maintain any mitigation requirements imposed by the director.
rules.quote: An operator must implement and maintain any mitigation requirements when imposed by the director.

rules.requirement: Owner must apply for the license on a form approved by the director and pay the required fees.
rules.quote: To obtain a new operator license, a person who owns the housing unit to be licensed as a short-term rental must apply on a form approved by the director and pay any fees required by this chapter.

rules.requirement: Owner must provide required application information, including a certification of no outstanding code violations, contact details, the rental address, a self-certified safety checklist, and the platforms to be used.
rules.quote: At a minimum, an applicant must provide the following information:

rules.requirement: Owner must obtain a third-party inspection showing the unit is not a hazard to life, health, or public safety if required by the director due to violations within the prior 24 months.
rules.quote: Before issuing an operator’s license, the director may require the applicant to obtain a third-party inspection that demonstrates the housing unit does not pose a hazard to life, health, or public safety when the short-term rental is the subject of one or more state law or City Code violations within the prior 24 months.

rules.requirement: Owner must update application information and pay renewal and notification fees to renew the operator's license.
rules.quote: To renew an operator’s license, the operator must:

rules.requirement: Owner must provide proof of payment of hotel occupancy taxes due when renewing if not using a platform that collects payments.
rules.quote: pr ovide proof of payment of hotel occupancy taxes due as of the date of submission of the application if the operator is not using a platform to collect payments for the use or possession, or for the right to the use or possession, of a short-term rental.

rules.requirement: Owner must obtain a third-party inspection before renewal if required by the director due to outstanding violations.
rules.quote: If the short-term rental is the subject of outstanding state law or City Code violations, the director may require the applicant to obtain a third-party inspection that demonstrates the housing unit does not pose a hazard to life, health, or public safety before renewing the operator’s license.

rules.requirement: Owner may not accept new bookings while an appeal of a revocation or denial is pending.
rules.quote: While an appeal is pending, an operator may not accept new bookings or rentals but may honor bookings or rentals accepted before:

rules.requirement: Owner must apply to renew an existing license at least 30 days before it expires.
rules.quote: To renew an existing short-term rental license, an operator must apply to renew the license at least 30 days before the license expires.
